comment: Board semantics, asserted from both languages. `schema-cases/` proves the two parsers read the same bytes; this proves they *reason* about the result identically. A board can be structurally valid and logically broken, so the suites stay separate. A reject case also carries `error`, a substring of the message, so the suite asserts *which* rule fired: on a queens board several rules apply at once and the wrong one firing would otherwise pass.

access.note: Python indexed the tuple and raised IndexError, which is not the Board's error type and does not name the cell. Raised here as a BoardError so both languages fail the same way.
